newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia ASB eyes Mincor stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia ASB eyes Mincor stake.

text.p: Malaysian property and timber company Advance Synergy Bhd (ASB) said it was planning to buy a 27 percent stake in Canadian gold-mining company Mincor Resources Inc..
The stake would result in ASB having effective control of Mincor, ASB said in a statement on Friday.
ASB stock was suspended on Friday morning pending the announcement, but has since been requoted.

The deal involves ASB buying an off-the-shelf British Virgin Islands-based company which will subsequently take up a placement of 6.1 million Mincor shares at 33 Canadian cents per share. The total consideration for the deal is $2 million.
Mincor is involved in gold mining in Zimbabwe, Mozambique and the U.S.A.
ASB stock was up 4 cents at 4.06 ringgit in late afternoon trading.
